 Hon'Ble Sri Justice J. Sreenivas Rao
 Writ Petition No.3507 of 2025
Order:

entities.text: Sadu Narasimha Reddy vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed seeking to issue direction to the respondents to issue notice to the petitioners in the land acquisition proceedings of Pharma City Project for the land situated in Sy.Nos.91//2 in Punjaguda Village, Kandukur Mandal, Ranga Reddy District (herein after referred to as 'subject property') belonging to the petitioners.
2.

Heard Sri P.Suresh, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 9.
3.
With the consent of learned counsel for the parties, the writ petition is being disposed of at the stage of admission.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioners have purchased the land to an extent of Ac.1.00 gts. in Sy.Nos.91//2, through registered sale deed dated 29.09.2023 from the original owner by paying valuable sale consideration and since then they have been in possession and enjoyment of the subject property.

He further submits that the respondent authorities without issuing notice and without following the due procedure as contemplated under law, are trying to take possession of the subject property for the purpose of establishing Pharmacity.

Therefore,
Petitioners have submitted representation before respondent No.9 on 28.01.2025, requesting him to issue notice to them, before initiating land acquisition proceedings.

Inspite of the same, respondent N.9 has not taken any steps to consider the representation submitted by the petitioners and the action of respondents No.9 is gross violation of principles of natural justice.

5. Per contra, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, basing on the instructions furnished by respondent No.9, submits that the respondent authorities initiated proceedings exercising the powers conferred under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (herein after called as 'Act 30 of 2013') and issued notification under Section 11(1) of the Act 30 of 2013 and thereafter,
passed award on 30.04.2022, after following due procedure as contemplated under the Act 30 of 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He further submits that the petitioners purchased the subject property, subsequent to initiation of land acquisition proceedings under the provisions of the Act and passing of the award.
Hence, the writ petition filed by the petitioners is not maintainable under law.

6. Having considered the rival submissions made by the respective parties and after perusal of the material available on record, it reveals that petitioners are claiming rights over the subject property,
pursuant to registered sale deeds dated 29.09.2023, whereas respondent No.9 had initiated land Sadu Narasimha Reddy vs The State Of Telangana on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135823760/
1 acquisition proceedings on 20.06.2018 and passed award on 30.04.2022.

entities.text: Sadu Narasimha Reddy vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, this Court is of the considered view that the petitioners are not entitled for the relief sought in the writ petition.

However, liberty is granted to petitioners to avail the remedies as available under law.
7.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
